lines: A law firm focused on finance, with practices in public finance, asset securitization, commercial lending and bankruptcy.

lines: Makes medical products for infusion therapy, pharmacy preparation, airway and temperature management, hemodynamic monitoring, renal care and pain management.
Its Department of Finance alone covers revenue collection, utility billing, tax and parking enforcement, payroll, benefits and accounting.
